description:
Configuration settings for SegmentAccumulator behavior.

Fields:
    enforce_session_id: If True, reject events from differing session IDs.
    deduplicate_by_id: If True, ignore identical duplicate final segment IDs idempotently.
    auto_sort: If True, automatically maintain final segments sorted by start_time_ms.
    preserve_interim_on_speech_ended: If True, do not discard active interim on SPEECH_ENDED.

enforce_session_id.description: Reject events with mismatched session_id if accumulator is bound to a session
enforce_session_id.title: Enforce Session Id

deduplicate_by_id.description: Idempotently ignore duplicate final segment IDs rather than raising errors
deduplicate_by_id.title: Deduplicate By Id

auto_sort.description: Maintain segments in strict chronological order by start_time_ms
auto_sort.title: Auto Sort

preserve_interim_on_speech_ended.description: Whether to keep active interim hypothesis when SPEECH_ENDED arrives
preserve_interim_on_speech_ended.title: Preserve Interim On Speech Ended

title: AccumulatorConfig
